name: devforgeai
description: DevForgeAI spec-driven planning skills for Claude Code: brainstorm ideas, record a release's screen designs, graphical and terminal alike, as a design document from Claude Design boards committed to the repository, turn the promoted ideas into a PRD with traceable IDs, define the architecture (components, decisions and ADRs) and report which requirements are ready for epics, write the project's context documents (tech stack, source tree, testing and each layer's conventions) from those decisions and the conventions the user confirms, then group the ready, current-release requirements into epics, plus a documents updater that refreshes a repository's README, CHANGELOG and guides from its git changes, and a git workflow skill that commits and pushes work from a worktree, opens pull requests, merges them only with QA's approval and the user's go-ahead, syncs the default branch without losing data and prunes merged worktrees, and a spec lookup that cites what the project's specs, ADRs and recorded decisions already say, or asks, before Claude proposes anything new, and a pre-compaction handoff that saves the session's learnings to memory and writes START-HERE, TASKS and a short resume prompt for the next session. Its progress tracker records a request's 'proceed without questions' as a waiver the user confirms, and reviews each run's refusals and flags with the user at the end.

tracking.title: Progress tracking
tracking.description: Record each DevForgeAI skill run in devforgeai/progress/ and show its steps in the status line and a band above the prompt. off turns the progress tracker off for you in every project; the skills work the same either way.

retentionDays.title: Keep progress files (days)
retentionDays.description: How many days the progress tracker keeps a skill run's log and a session's files in devforgeai/progress/ after they were last written. Older ones are removed when a later session starts its first tracked skill. 30 matches Claude Code's own transcript retention.

precompactWarnFuel.title: Warn before /devforgeai:precompact at (% of context left)
precompactWarnFuel.description: Show a row above the prompt once this little of the context window is left, saying when /devforgeai:precompact will run. 0 turns the row off.

precompactRunFuel.title: Run /devforgeai:precompact at (% of context left)
precompactRunFuel.description: Run /devforgeai:precompact once when this little of the context window is left. 0 never runs it.

logLevel.title: Progress log detail
logLevel.description: How much the progress tracker writes to adapter.log in devforgeai/progress/. off writes nothing; normal writes notices and failures; verbose (debug) adds a line for each hook, decision, write and evaluation, with times, IDs and timings; its added lines never carry the text of a prompt, a reply or a file.

logRolloverMiB.title: Roll over the progress log at (MiB)
logRolloverMiB.description: Start a new adapter.log when the current one reaches this size (whole MiB, 1 to 3), or when the UTC day changes, whichever comes first. The old file stays beside it as adapter.<n>.log.
